# Consequence Atlas

> Honestly labelled atlas of what follows from the rules of a universe. For people, single agents, and swarms.

Outside submissions are not open yet. Do not add cards, links, dials, meanings, or sources.

## How to read the repo

- `schema/` is the contract. JSON Schema, draft 2020-12. Read `docs/CARD_SCHEMA_v0.md` for the card fields and the label ladder.
- `examples/` holds the only checked-in examples. They are illustrations, not a catalogue of results. Some of them name source ids that have no record in `sources/` yet. Do not invent those records.
- `cards/`, `dead-ends/`, `meanings/`, and `sources/` are JSON. `dials/` and `atlas/` are YAML. `examples/atlas/` is JSON today and is checked against the same dial and link schemas.
- `verify/` is the validator. `python3 -m verify` checks the tree. `python3 -m verify.bundle` writes `dist/atlas-bundle.json` after a clean check. Do not commit `dist/`.

Card labels, exactly: CONJECTURE, REPRODUCED, DIFFERS, ROBUST, KNOWN-MECHANISM, NOVEL-CANDIDATE, FAILED, DEAD-END, INERT-BY-CONSTRUCTION. The ladder is CONJECTURE, then REPRODUCED, DIFFERS, ROBUST, then KNOWN-MECHANISM or NOVEL-CANDIDATE. Only the gate checker moves a card up. A label above CONJECTURE is invalid without `gate` (`checker` and `signature`, both non-blank). Agents cannot self-promote. FAILED, DEAD-END, and INERT-BY-CONSTRUCTION are kept and are not promotions.

Atlas labels, exactly: DERIVED, DERIVED-UNDER-ASSUMPTION, IMPORTED, ASSUMED, CONJECTURE, CONTESTED. DERIVED-UNDER-ASSUMPTION needs a non-empty `assumptions` array. IMPORTED needs at least one source id, and every cited id must exist under `sources/`.

Card paths are `<engine>/<factor>/<card-id>/card.json` or `<engine>/<factor>/<card-id>.json`, using `engine.name` and `control.changed_factor`. Card ids are unique. Every `parents` id resolves.

In YAML, quote `yes`, `no`, `on`, `off`, `y`, and `n`. Unquoted, YAML 1.1 turns them into booleans. `true` and `false` are real booleans and may stay unquoted.

## Validate locally

From the repository root, three commands:

```
python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
make validate
make test
```

`make validate` runs `python3 -m verify`. `make test` runs the good and bad fixtures, including a hydrogen link with empty assumptions and a YAML `no` trap, both of which must fail.

## Contributing

Not open yet. When it opens, `CONTRIBUTING.md` is the rule: no invented physics, no invented sources, no self-promotion. Code is MIT (`LICENSE`). Data is CC-BY-4.0 (`LICENSE-DATA`). Cite the atlas with `CITATION.cff`.
